question: footway roads geojson
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 5;

question: residential road names lengths metres
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true))) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' AND names.primary IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;

question: tertiary road start end coords
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 6) AS start_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 6) AS start_lat, ROUND(ST_X(ST_EndPoint(geometry)), 6) AS end_lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_EndPoint(geometry)), 6) AS end_lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'tertiary' AND names.primary IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;

question: paved roads maxspeed 30 wkt
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE list_contains(list_transform(road_surface, x -> x.value), 'paved') AND list_contains(list_transform(speed_limits, x -> x.max_speed.value), 30) LIMIT 5;

question: secondary roads bbox wkt
sql: SELECT ST_AsText(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS bbox_wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'secondary';

question: service road centroids geojson
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS centroid_geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'service' AND names.primary IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;
